food_name: Clementine juice, fresh squeezed, cv Comune, Cetraro, Calabria, Italy

raw_or_processed_state: Freshly squeezed juice, centrifuged and filtered for analysis; standard juice before by-product enrichment or pasteurization
synonym_verification_status: Exact hesperidin analyte quantified against authentic hesperidin standard; retention time and characteristic spectra used for identification

sample_size: n=3 analytical replicates for each regional juice sample; 25 fruits collected per region, not reported as independent sample-level chemistry
source_title: Citrus × Clementina Hort. Juice Enriched with Its By-Products (Peels and Leaves): Chemical Composition, In Vitro Bioactivity, and Impact of Processing

extraction_notes: Reported concentration retained exactly in mg/100 mL; normalized value converted to mg/L by multiplying by 10. Source juice is pre-enrichment fresh-squeezed juice.
uncertainty_notes: SD reflects triplicate analytical replicates, not independent fruit or market-lot variability. Twenty-five fruits were collected per region but pooled sample chemistry is presented. Seasonal/date and commercial-market representativeness are limited.
